unit_cn: Unit 2 Bridging Cultures 沟通文化
source: 人教版2019选择性必修二 Unit 2 词表(真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、留学/文化交流/文化适应主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Adaptation to a new culture takes time and patience.
words.example_cn: 适应一种新文化需要时间和耐心。

words.example_en: At first, Xie Lei had to adapt to life in a different country.
words.example_cn: 起初,谢蕾不得不适应在异国的生活。

words.meaning_cn: 追求的目标;夙愿;抱负;野心
words.example_en: Her ambition is to set up a business in China after graduation.
words.example_cn: 她的抱负是毕业后在中国创办一家企业。

words.example_en: An ambitious student is never afraid of a new challenge.
words.example_cn: 一个有抱负的学生从不害怕新的挑战。

words.example_en: Every applicant for the exchange programme must write a personal essay.
words.example_cn: 每位交换项目的申请人都必须写一篇个人短文。

words.example_en: Students should think about their family's budget before studying abroad.
words.example_cn: 学生在出国留学前应考虑家庭的预算。

words.example_en: Her tutor said she must acknowledge others if she cited their ideas.
words.example_cn: 她的导师说,如果引用别人的观点,她必须注明出处。

words.example_en: When she misses home, a second family gives her great comfort.
words.example_cn: 想家时,第二个家庭给了她极大的安慰。

words.example_en: Studying abroad helps you improve your general competence.
words.example_cn: 出国留学有助于提高你的综合能力。

words.example_en: China needs young people who are highly competent with languages.
words.example_cn: 中国需要语言能力很强的年轻人。

words.example_en: Living in a new culture can be more complex than students expect.
words.example_cn: 生活在新文化中可能比学生预想的更复杂。

words.example_en: Cooperating with people from diverse backgrounds gives us new insight.
words.example_cn: 与不同背景的人合作能给我们新的洞察。

words.example_en: One cannot deny the fact that studying abroad has its difficulties.
words.example_cn: 人们无法否认出国留学有其困难这一事实。

words.example_en: He will still remember his Chinese friends long after his departure.
words.example_cn: 离开很久之后,他仍会记得他的中国朋友。

words.example_en: Failing to make friends abroad can depress many young students.
words.example_cn: 在国外交不到朋友会让许多年轻学生感到沮丧。

words.example_en: Some students feel depressed when they first face culture shock.
words.example_cn: 一些学生初次面对文化冲击时会感到沮丧。

words.meaning_cn: 巨大的;急剧的;戏剧性的
words.example_en: There has been a dramatic increase in the number of people studying abroad.
words.example_cn: 出国留学的人数急剧增加。

words.meaning_cn: (报刊的)一份;(节目的)一期;版次
words.example_en: We will follow Xie Lei's progress in later editions of the magazine.
words.example_cn: 我们将在杂志的后续各期中关注谢蕾的进展。

words.example_en: Engaging in British culture has helped her feel at home.
words.example_cn: 融入英国文化让她感到自在。

words.example_en: Chinese students abroad can be seen as cultural envoys promoting friendship.
words.example_cn: 海外的中国学生可被视为促进友谊的文化使者。

words.example_en: The advisor talked about keeping reasonable expectations when studying abroad.
words.example_cn: 顾问谈到了留学时要保持合理的期望。

words.example_en: Tuition fees and living expenses are much higher than at home.
words.example_cn: 学费和生活费比在国内高得多。

words.example_en: Studying abroad exposes students to a whole new way of thinking.
words.example_cn: 出国留学使学生接触到一种全新的思维方式。

words.example_en: Exposure to another culture can give students great insights into the world.
words.example_cn: 接触另一种文化能给学生对世界的深刻见解。

words.example_en: Studying abroad helps you gain a global perspective.
words.example_cn: 出国留学有助于你获得全球视野。

words.example_en: It was difficult for her to grasp the Chinese tones at first.
words.example_cn: 起初她很难掌握汉语的声调。

words.example_en: Many exchange students suffer from homesickness in their first weeks.
words.example_cn: 许多交换生在最初几周饱受思乡之苦。

words.example_en: The Belt and Road Initiative has helped China connect with the world.
words.example_cn: “一带一路”倡议帮助中国与世界相连。

words.example_en: Cultural exchange gives us more insight into our own culture.
words.example_cn: 文化交流让我们对自己的文化有更深的洞察。

words.example_en: Getting involved in social activities is the best way to overcome culture shock.
words.example_cn: 积极参与社交活动是克服文化冲击的最佳方式。

words.meaning_cn: 合乎逻辑的;合情合理的
words.example_en: Good logical connectors help readers follow your reasoning.
words.example_cn: 好的逻辑连接词能帮助读者跟上你的推理。

words.example_en: Some students are not mature enough to handle the challenges alone.
words.example_cn: 有些学生还不够成熟,无法独自应对挑战。

words.example_en: She is acting as a cultural messenger between China and the UK.
words.example_cn: 她正充当中英之间的文化信使。

words.example_en: Living abroad can motivate students to work harder than ever.
words.example_cn: 在国外生活能激励学生比以往更努力。

words.meaning_cn: 积极的;主动的;有干劲的
words.example_en: She became more motivated after she made new friends abroad.
words.example_cn: 在国外结交新朋友后,她变得更有干劲了。

words.example_en: The motivation for Xie Lei to study abroad was to learn about global business.
words.example_cn: 谢蕾出国留学的动机是了解全球商业。

words.example_en: There are no great difficulties for a person who is brave and optimistic.
words.example_cn: 对于勇敢乐观的人来说,没有克服不了的困难。

words.example_en: She decided to stay positive about the outcome of her studies.
words.example_cn: 她决定对自己学业的结果保持乐观。

words.example_en: China's global outlook has helped it make connections across the world.
words.example_cn: 中国的全球视野帮助它与世界各地建立联系。

words.meaning_cn: 无法抗拒的;压倒性的;巨大的
words.example_en: The first few weeks abroad were absolutely overwhelming for her.
words.example_cn: 在国外的最初几周对她来说是难以承受的。

words.example_en: She was always ready to participate in the activities her college offered.
words.example_cn: 她总是乐于参加学院提供的各种活动。

words.example_en: Many courses include students' participation as part of the final result.
words.example_cn: 许多课程把学生的课堂参与作为期末成绩的一部分。

words.example_en: Studying abroad helps you gain a global perspective on the world.
words.example_cn: 出国留学有助于你获得看待世界的全球视角。

words.example_en: Her presentation on traditional Chinese art was a great success.
words.example_cn: 她关于中国传统艺术的演讲非常成功。

words.example_en: Xie Lei is studying for a business qualification at a Chinese university.
words.example_cn: 谢蕾正在一所中国大学攻读商科学历。

words.meaning_cn: 有道理的;合情理的;合理的
words.example_en: It is wise to keep reasonable expectations about life abroad.
words.example_cn: 对国外生活保持合理的期望是明智的。

words.example_en: "I was very excited but also quite nervous," Xie Lei recalled.
words.example_cn: “我很激动,但也相当紧张,”谢蕾回忆道。

words.example_en: Understanding the setting helps you understand the conversation more clearly.
words.example_cn: 理解情景有助于你更清楚地理解对话。

words.example_en: Talented young people will help further strengthen our country.
words.example_cn: 有才华的年轻人将帮助进一步增强我们的国家。

words.example_en: Some students suffer from culture shock in new surroundings.
words.example_cn: 一些学生在新环境中会遭遇文化冲击。

words.example_en: Studying abroad comes with tremendous pressure for many students.
words.example_cn: 对许多学生来说,出国留学伴随着巨大的压力。

words.example_en: Her tutor advised her to read a lot in order to form her own opinions.
words.example_cn: 她的导师建议她广泛阅读以形成自己的观点。
